thread:
alex: Heads up — eviction storm in eu-central GPU pool. Several nodes failing driver init; autoscaler is thrashing and we’re seeing throughput at ~45% and queueing spiking.

infra-bot: alert -> region=eu-central, severity=critical, affected_pools=gpu-pool-a,gpu-pool-b, active_evictions=14, estimated_recovery=~90m

julia: what's the immediate customer impact?

alex: Affected: best-effort workloads and some mid-tier reserved bursts. Tail latency up, retries causing token bursts upstream.

marco: Recommend emergency fairshare: apply per-customer soft throttles for non-reserved traffic, route new best-effort sessions to eu-west, and enable aggressive KV caching for heavy embedding jobs.

sam: I can author the policy and run a dry-run. Draft policy:
```
policy: emergency_throttle
region: eu-central
apply_to: non-reserved
qps_limit: "0.75 * baseline"
fallback_region: eu-west
kv_cache: enabled
token_penalty_multiplier: 1.25
notify: #ops
```

julia: We must whitelist enterprise customers and any active reserved pools. Marco, drop me the enterprise list.

marco: sharing enterprise tenant IDs via DM. Two medium customers (tenant-8675, tenant-4421) may still be impacted; propose overrides to 0.9 baseline for them and proactive credits if they accept.

alex: Agreed. Sam, run dry-run and flag any tenants hitting the softcap for >2m so we can notify.

sam: dry-run complete. Estimated overall QPS reduction 28%. Reserved tenants unaffected. The two medium tenants would breach; applying overrides now for those two.

infra-bot: action=policy_apply requested_by=sam at=1955501305

sam: applying policy (dry-run passed). Scheduling smart-route change to prefer eu-west for new best-effort sessions, ramp over 3 minutes to avoid downstream surge.

infra-bot: route_swap scheduled -> from=eu-central,best-effort to=eu-west,best-effort at=1955501335

marco: rolling kernel-driver patch to a canary subset in the affected pools. Watching for regressions.

julia: I'll send a short customer-facing blurb to support/sales: "Temporary softcap in eu-central due to degraded GPU capacity. Enterprise reservations preserved; we're routing best-effort to eu-west. DM ops for concerns." :lock:

alex: Monitoring metrics: queue depth dropping, p50/p95 latency for best-effort improving ~18% after route swap.

sam: watch egress/egress-cost alarms — routing to eu-west increases cross-region egress for some customers. Flag any budget alerts.

marco: note for retro: add bootstrap-time driver compatibility check and fail nodes early to avoid cascade.

infra-bot: recovery_check initiated at=1955501760; status=monitoring

alex: after 20m stability p95 within 12% of baseline, queue depth stable. Recommend gradual rollback of softcaps after 15 more minutes.

julia: approvals received from sales for 10% credit to the two medium tenants. They've accepted the compensation.

sam: beginning rollback now in a phased manner.

infra-bot: policy_rollback completed at=1955502520

alex: all softcaps removed; normal routing restored. Will keep heightened monitoring for an hour.

marco: adding post-incident action: automated node-bootstrap driver sanity check + alert on repeated bootstrap failures.

julia: final customer note sent. Thanks team.
